verdict.rationale: Fenwick publicly states it uses alternative fee arrangements (fixed fee, value-based, task-based, risk-sharing) and quantifies that over 20% of revenue comes from non-hourly billing, plus offers real-time budget-tracking dashboards for clients — concrete evidence of fee-transparency practices beyond opaque hourly billing. However, no specific rate cards, sample fee ranges, or detailed public rate structures are disclosed. Missing for 10: published rate ranges/sample pricing tiers, client testimonials on AFA outcomes, independent corroboration of the 20% figure.
